selection_rationale: A non-Qwen code-instruct family with a comparable parameter scale and a native 128K context window, allowing the frozen 28,672-token input cap to remain unchanged. The model was selected before any Yi-Coder prediction on the consumed holdout was generated.
failure_policy: Retain every selected sample in the 300-sample denominator. Do not regenerate or repair a prediction after viewing it. Mechanical generation failures or token-limit hits are retained as incorrect and reported explicitly.
interpretation: The consumed holdout is reused only for labeled post-hoc cross-family robustness. No prompt, parser, compiler, verifier, threshold, method, or output cap may be tuned from these outputs.
